notes: German-language site (SAP Commerce/Hybris storefront, fully client-rendered React SPA - Tier 1 direct HTTP fetch returns an empty shell, used Tier 2 Playwright/CDP for all page reads). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot - none named). Discovery: fetched robots.txt-listed sitemap-categories.xml (68k+ URLs) and grepped for German seasonal/holiday slugs (weihnacht*, advent*, ostern/osterdeko, fruehling, herbst, halloween, silvester/neujahr, fasching/karneval, valentin, nikolaus, erntedank, st-patrick) across the WHOLE sitemap, not just the decor branch; cross-checked against the live 'Weihnachtsdekoration' (Christmas) category page's own sub-nav via Playwright DOM read, which surfaced one node ('Weihnachtstextilien', Christmas Textiles) not present in the (evidently slightly stale) sitemap. Only Christmas, Easter, Spring and a combined Autumn/Halloween node exist in the site's actual taxonomy; no Valentine's Day, New Year/Silvester, Carnival/Fasching, St. Nicholas/Nikolaus, or Thanksgiving-equivalent categories were found anywhere in the sitemap or nav. All qty values are the exact 'X Artikel' PLP header count (German thousands-separator '.' parsed, e.g. '1.581 Artikel' = 1581). Christmas has a top grouping category (own displayed count 4.201 Artikel, but its 10 listed sub-nav children are subsets of that count per the shared overlap rule, so the parent is recorded as a grouping row with qty:null rather than double-counted); within it, 'Weihnachtsbaumschmuck' (Christmas Tree Ornaments) and 'Weihnachtsbeleuchtung' (Christmas Lighting) are themselves sub-parents whose own displayed counts (1.581 and 223 respectively) are supersets of their one/two listed children, so they are also recorded as grouping rows for the same reason. Excluded https://www.xxxlutz.de/c/weihnachtskerzen-kerzenhalter ('Weihnachtskerzen & Kerzenhalter') as a curated marketing/highlights sub-page (no own product-count header, explicit 'Zurueck zur Weihnachtsbeleuchtung Uebersicht' back-link into the real Weihnachtsbeleuchtung category) rather than a genuine standalone PLP. 'Winterdeko' (Winter Decoration) is filed by the site as a direct child of Weihnachtsdekoration (breadcrumb Produkte > Dekoration > Weihnachtsdekoration), so it is bucketed under Christmas per the site's own hierarchy even though its own name is generically winter-themed, not explicitly Christmas-themed. The 'Herbstdeko & Halloweendeko' node combines Autumn/Fall decor and Halloween decor in one single PLP with one shared count and no sub-nav to split them (majority of visible products are Halloween-themed, but a real minority are generic autumn wreaths) - kept under the site's own combined name per the flagging rule for an unresolvable holiday split rather than guessing a single holiday. Room/product-type overlap with other completed category workbooks (Lighting, Wall Decor, etc.) is expected and intentional per the Seasonal rules - no other workbook was touched.
